definitions.explanation: The act of maintaining social relationships or keeping company with others.
A romantic involvement between two people.

examples.japanese: {近所|きんじょ}{付|つ}き{合|あ}いは{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Getting along with neighbors is important.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}の{付|つ}き{合|あ}いで{飲|の}みに{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went drinking as a work social obligation.

examples.japanese: {二人|ふたり}の{付|つ}き{合|あ}いは{長|なが}い。
examples.english: The two of them have been together for a long time.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
・{付|つ}き{合|あ}いがいい (sociable, easy to get along with)
・{付|つ}き{合|あ}いが{悪|わる}い (unsociable, hard to get along with)
・{付|つ}き{合|あ}いで〜する (to do ~ as a social obligation)

COMMON COMPOUND WORDS:
・{近所|きんじょ}{付|つ}き{合|あ}い (neighborly relations)
・{仕事|しごと}の{付|つ}き{合|あ}い (work-related socializing)
・お{付|つ}き{合|あ}い (polite form; also used for romantic relationship)

USAGE NOTE:
{付|つ}き{合|あ}い often implies social obligations that one feels compelled to participate in, especially in business contexts.
